title: Sal Is It
lines: Pam, Dan and Sal ran in the sun.
"I am it!" said Pam. She ran at Dan.
Dan ran and ran. Pam can not tag him.
Sal is a tot. She sat and was sad.
Pam ran to Sal. "Can we tag Dan?"
Sal and Pam ran at Dan and got him!
"Sal got me!" said Dan. Sal ran and ran.
"Sal is it!" said Pam. Sal ran at Dan.

questions.ask: Who was it at the start of the game?
questions.listenFor: Pam. Line two says it. If your child is not sure, put a finger on that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: Why was Sal sitting down and feeling sad?
questions.listenFor: She is a tot, so she was not in the game. Line four says it. Let them reread it rather than being told.

questions.ask: Pam asked Sal to help her tag Dan. Was that a good idea? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason from the story, like two runners are faster than one, or Sal was left out before.
